'''Klubi Futbollistik Besiana''' (KF Besiana) was a [[football (soccer)|football]] club based in [[Podujevo]] (known in [[Albanian language|Albanian]] as ''Besiana''), [[Kosovo]]. It was founded in 1984<ref>[http://www.weltfussballarchiv.com/club_profile.php?ID=9807 KF Besiana] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160915043643/http://www.weltfussballarchiv.com/club_profile.php?ID=9807 |date=2016-09-15 }} at Weltfussballarchiv.com</ref> and played in the second division of football in Kosovo, [[Liga e Parë]]. Legendary former [[Kosovo]] footballer [[Fadil Vokrri]] is one of founders of the club.<ref name="fenerbahce.org">[http://www.fenerbahce.org/icerik/haber/11169/ KF Besiana, brother team from Kosovo]</ref> KF Besiana won the [[Football Superleague of Kosovo|Kosovar Superliga]] and the [[Kosovar Cup]] during the 2001/02 season."}}
